 © 2026 Yahoo. All rights reserved. The Pittsburgh Steelers quarterbacks room, including QBs coach Tom Arth , arrived in style for Sunday's game against the New Orleans Saints in Paris. The QBs were wearing a classic 1920s Peaky Blinders style look.
 With the game in Paris, it's only fitting that the Steelers QBs wore a vintage, fashionable look.
 The #Steelers QB room arrived in style for today's game in Paris vs. the Saints:
From left to right: Drew Allar, Mason Rudolph, QBs coach Tom Arth, Aaron Rodgers and Will Howard. pic.twitter.com/D59dNRYjsh 
 — Ari Meirov (@MySportsUpdate) October 25, 2026 
 Steelers right guard Brock Hoffman also paid homage to Aaron Rodgers before Sunday's game by wearing his No. 8 Cal Bears jersey.
 . @BrockHoffman76 reppin @AaronRodgers12 🤝 pic.twitter.com/dVyx86k6WJ 
 — Pittsburgh Steelers (@steelers) October 25, 2026 
 The Steelers will also be fashionable on the field, as they'll debut a never-before-worn uniform combination for their game in Paris , the team announced 24 hours before the game against the Saints.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement The Steelers will be pairing their traditional white road uniform tops wth the black pants with a thick gold stripe that the team usually wears as part of its color rush jerseys.
 While many NFL teams routinely mix and match their different uniform combinations, this is a first for the Steelers, who wear the same gold pants with their home and road uniforms. They wear khaki-colored pants for their vertically striped throwback uniforms.
 That uniform, which debuted last year , was the last time the Steelers unveiled a new look. Pittsburgh previously wore 1970s throwbacks with block numbers and gray facemasks. They have also worn horizontally striped "bumble bee" 1934 throwbacks and 1960s-era black uniforms with gold helmets.
 The Steelers will still be wearing their full color rush uniforms, which they've been wearing since 2016, at a later date, as well as their throwbacks.
